items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: So I get to work and I said, “Bill, I just had dinner with Benny and he told me that you wrote a couple of charts for the band.”

ctx.x: Yeah. A very good drummer, he was with Frank all those great years. And he said, “Peter, how are you?” I said, “Fine, Irv, how are you?” He said, “Good.” He said, “We were talking about you last night.” I said, “Who, me? Who?” He said, “Bill Miller,” pianist, “and Frank and me.” I said, “What are you talking about me for?” He said, “Well Frank wants to use vibes at the Eros, and Bill Miller said, “‘Well why don’t we get Peter Appleyard?’” So Frank said, “Peter Appleyard?” He said, “Yeah.” He said, “He works with…
I guess you solved that problem of not being able to get tickets to the show.
